qt: to the Commission Tineke Strik (Verts/ALE), Erik Marquardt (Verts/ALE), Hannah Neumann (Verts/ALE) Subject:

According to Articles 12(3) and 17(1)(b) of the Screening Regulation1, indications of statelessness must be identified and recorded during the screening process. In addition, Articles 27(2) and 29(4)(a) of the Asylum Procedure Regulation2 require Member States to register claims of statelessness in the asylum procedure pending determination of whether the claimant is stateless. Nevertheless, monitoring by civil society3 found that only 3 of the 15 national implementation plans publicly available in May 2026 referenced these obligations. 1.

Has the Commission checked whether all Member States have operational procedures, trained staff and recording systems in place to fulfil their obligation to identify indications of statelessness under the Screening Regulation, and have any gaps been identified and corrective measures requested?

Will the Commission’s forthcoming revision of the Practical Handbook for Border Guards include specific guidance on identifying indications of statelessness during screening, on distinguishing statelessness from unknown nationality, on standards for recording these indications, and on the transfer of such information between screening, asylum and return authorities?

How does the Commission plan to assess and ensure compliance with Articles 27(2) and 29(4)(a) of the Asylum Procedure Regulation, particularly given that it remains unclear in many Member States what procedures are in place for determining statelessness, and what further action will be taken to address this?

Regulation (EU) 2024/1356 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 May 2024 introducing the screening of third-country nationals at the external borders and amending Regulations (EC) No 767/2008, (EU) 2017/2226, (EU) 2018/1240 and (EU) 2019/817 (OJ L, 2024/1356, 22.5.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1356/oj). 2 Regulation (EU) 2024/1348 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 14 May 2024 establishing a common procedure for international protection in the Union and repealing Directive 2013/32/EU (OJ L, 2024/1348, 22.5.2024, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2024/1348/oj). 3 European Network on Statelessness, ‘Applying the statelessness provisions in the EU Pact on Migration and Asylum’, briefing, European Network on Statelessness, London, May 2026. 1
